summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field after _get_time; finished property now checks finished_time; capture in Progress.update and Progress.advance as the last step under the lock; clears in Task._reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column unit test, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn, expected output regenerated by hand-tracing the mock clock); tests/test_palette.py (new, asserts 16 rows). Not run: tests were not executed per instructions. Verification was by reading and byte counts: 25/16-char bars, 12 yellow cells. The main risk is the hand-derived test_columns expectation, which could be wrong if a clock read was miscounted.
